title: A Quadratic Lens on Muon's Polar Update: Benefits, Pitfalls, and the Role of Newton-Schulz
abstract: arXiv:2610.30280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon updates matrix-valued parameters along approximately orthogonalized directions and often trains large language models faster than AdamW, yet it remains unclear when and why orthogonalization helps. We study PolarGD, the orthogonalized update at the core of Muon, on matrix quadratics, where optimizers can be analyzed in closed form, and compare update directions under line search to remove the effect of learning-rate tuning. Orthogonalization pays off when the gradient is far from low rank and its largest singular directions see high curvature. PolarGD reaches the minimizer in one step whenever the rows of the error are orthogonal with equal norms, for any Hessian, whereas gradient descent needs all Hessian eigenvalues to be equal; and unlike sign descent, PolarGD is unaffected by rotations of the problem. translated_title: 二次型视角下的Muon极化更新：收益、陷阱与Newton-Schulz的作用
translated_abstract: Muon沿近似正交化的方向更新矩阵值参数，训练大语言模型的速度通常快于AdamW，但正交化在何时以及为何有效仍不清楚。我们在矩阵二次型问题上研究Muon核心的正交化更新方法PolarGD，在此类问题上优化器可以进行闭式分析，并在线搜索下比较不同更新方向，以排除学习率调节的影响。当梯度远离低秩、且其最大奇异方向具有高曲率时，正交化才能带来收益。只要误差的各行相互正交且范数相等，无论Hessian如何，PolarGD都能一步到达极小值点，而梯度下降则需要所有Hessian特征值相等；与符号下降不同，PolarGD不受问题旋转的影响。在多步迭代中，PolarGD相当于以当前迭代点为预条件子的梯度下降，因此其速度由条件数决定。
tldr: 该论文在矩阵二次型问题上对Muon核心的PolarGD正交化更新进行闭式分析，揭示其收益（梯度远离低秩且最大奇异方向高曲率时有效、误差行正交等范数时可一步收敛、具有旋转不变性）与陷阱，并阐明了Newton-Schulz正交化的作用。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a closed-form analysis of Muon's core PolarGD orthogonalized update on matrix quadratics, showing that orthogonalization pays off only when the gradient is far from low rank with high curvature in its top singular directions, enables one-step convergence under orthogonal equal-norm error rows, is rotation-invariant unlike sign descent, and clarifies the role of Newton-Schulz.
